_comment: The canonical request used to verify a CONTESTED auction: one impression that
both seats can bid on. Kept in the repo, not in /tmp, because a request that
only exists on someone's laptop cannot be part of a deployed capability.
Every field below is load-bearing:
cur: ["USD"]                  - the ARRAY form, which is what OpenRTB 2.x
specifies and what Prebid Server sends. A
bare string here would stop this fixture
from catching a regression of the defect
that made assert_supported_currency raise
AttributeError and return 500.
site.cat / imp.ext.artf.categories
- 'home' is what makes camp-cedar eligible;
without it artfhouse has nothing to bid.
pmp.deals[].id                 - deal-home-premium is a REAL id from
source/demand/artfhouse/catalog.py. An
invented id returns no bid, which looks
identical to a broken service.
pmp.private_auction: 0         - open-market candidates may still compete,
which is what gives the auction a second
artfhouse bid alongside the deal bid.
imp.ext.artfhouse: {}          - REQUIRED, and empty on purpose. Prebid routes
an impression to a bidder only when
imp.ext.<bidder> is PRESENT; the adapter takes
no parameters, but without this key artfhouse
is never called and appears in neither
seatbid nor seatnonbid.
imp.ext.amt.placementId        - required by the AMT adapter's amt.json.
Present so this same fixture works once the
amt seat is injected; artfhouse never sees
it, because Prebid rewrites the request per
bidder.
ext.prebid.returnallbidstatus  - populates ext.seatnonbid, which is where the
LOSERS are reported. Without it a losing
seat is indistinguishable from a seat that
was never called.
ext.prebid.multibid            - lets a seat return more than one bid, so a
deal bid and an open-market bid from the
same seat both survive to the response.
